pages.text: $(bold)ORSA Mk.I Thermal Undersuit$()$(br2)Wool and leather, designed by ORSA's finest interns.$(li)+6.25°C cold resistance per piece$(li)Full set: $(bold)+25°C$()$(li)Rated for Phase 1-3 (-25°C)$(li)Not rated for Phase 4+, lava or bear hugs

Wool and leather. Your grandmother could make this. She probably should have.
Keeps your ears warm and your dignity... debatable.
Wool-lined trousers for survivors who prefer their knees unfrozen.
Cold feet end expeditions fast. These help you keep walking.
